children: US Army takes another step to fast-tracking procurement of Elsight's uncrewed systems connectivity
ALLEN, Texas, Sept. 15, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Elsight (
), a provider of mission-critical connectivity for uncrewed systems, today announced it has secured an official listing on the US Army's UAS Marketplace
as an early addition to the platform

. The listing follows a Basic Ordering Agreement with the U.S. Army and Halo's addition to the Blue UAS List. Halo's inclusion reflects DoW validation of the capability and puts the product within easier reach of the U.S. Army, other branches of the U.S. Armed Forces, and partner nations.

Elsight's Halo technology enables uncrewed operations beyond visual line of sight (BVLOS) across air, land, and maritime domains. Field-proven with over 500,000 operational hours across 100+ customers with active deployments in complex, high-intensity combat environments, Halo intelligently bonds cellular, satellite, and RF communications into one resilient connectivity layer that intelligently selects the optimal path. Halo is in operational use in conflict front lines across the globe and has been showcased at US military events for the Defense Innovation Unit (DIU) and US Special Operations Command (SOCOM).

"This listing streamlines the procurement process and puts Halo within easy reach of every program office across the US Army and beyond," said Elsight CEO Yoav Amitai. "We were ahead of the curve on this because resilient connectivity has become a baseline requirement for uncrewed systems on the modern battlefield. Halo is already trusted in various front lines around the globe, and we're proud that Army buyers can now reach it directly through the Marketplace as the service scales its uncrewed systems programs."

Elsight is scaling up manufacturing in the US and Germany to meet growing government demand for localized, resilient supply chains, as NATO-aligned defense forces and US agencies increasingly adopt its technology. Several programs are set to move from pilot to full production procurement.
Key Halo Features
The only multi-link solution intelligently bonding all available communications
Zero-interruption spectrum handoff
Leverages existing and proprietary infrastructure, turning it into an intelligent, available, and cost-effective layer in the mission stack
Vendor agnostic integration across airframes, ground vehicles, vessels, and communication hardware without lock-in
Optimized for both tiny platforms and heavy-duty systems without added bulk or power draw
Scale without re-architecting –one drone or a full fleet, the platform grows with the operation
About Elsight
Elsight (

) provides the critical enablement layer for uncrewed vehicles, across air, land and maritime domains. Trusted by leading autonomous systems manufacturers, defense organizations, and public safety agencies worldwide, Elsight supports mission-critical uncrewed systems operations, where reliability, mobility, and mission certainty matter most.
